scope_deviations: Pin cryptography dependency/uv.lock; Alembic registry imports auth models.
Narrow historical profile-schema metadata parity to users; new auth suite checks full head metadata.
design: AES-256-GCM via cryptography; fresh 96-bit nonce; version/key_id authenticated with row/owner/field context; explicit 32-byte keys only in process keyring.
SHA256 of random 256-bit cookie/state/browser binding tokens. Mandatory browser nonce hash for attempts; nullable attempt user_id per task.
Add explicit local session expires_at in addition to upstream access expiry. No authentication claims or provider I/O.
Store owns no commit: caller wraps a single command transaction. OAuth consume must COMMIT before future external code exchange.
No onboarding_draft column/API until the first draft command; no generic JSON input that could persist a password.
User docs deletions/Copilot additions untouched; relevant requirements read from HEAD.

Private table policies scope true predicates to studio_auth_runtime only; no global private-schema/default grants. UPDATE limited to revoked_at or consumed_at; broader refresh/cleanup privileges not granted ahead of commands.
AEAD AAD also binds expiration times and session hash/upstream UUID or attempt provider/browser/state/path. Datetimes canonicalized to UTC; secret DTO fields use SecretStr.
One coherent schema/store card: most diff is executable crypto/DB negative cases and pinned dependency hashes.
